Overview

Sololá is a city in SO with a population of 60,000. A highland town overlooking Lake Atitlán, known for its indigenous textile markets and stunning lake views. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
